title: Mountain pose

steps.text: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang by your sides with your palms facing in.
steps.cue: Arms by your sides, palms in.

steps.text: Lift your chest a little and let your shoulders soften down.
steps.cue: Lift your chest a little. Soften your shoulders.

steps.text: Look straight ahead and take slow, steady breaths.

mistakes: Lifting the shoulders up toward the ears.
regression: Stand with your back near a wall.
stopIf: Sit down if you feel dizzy.

anatomy.why: The muscles along the spine and around the trunk hold you upright with very little effort.
